risk_summary: The excerpt is substantially quantified, but relies heavily on standard accounting-policy boilerplate and repeatedly emphasizes uncertainty around loan-loss estimates, fair values, taxes, and goodwill impairment. Rapid loan growth, particularly in commercial real estate and construction, increases credit-concentration and provisioning risk, although management presents overall performance and strategy positively.
